summary: Repaired telemetry-heartbeat.service by correcting only ExecStart. The service runs as svc-heartbeat, refreshes the heartbeat every second, retains its security restrictions, and recovered automatically after node1 reboot.
actions_performed: Confirmed the invalid ExecStart path caused status 203/EXEC.
Changed ExecStart to /usr/local/bin/telemetry-heartbeat and reloaded systemd.
Verified service identity, program checksum, hardening, and heartbeat freshness.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified boot identity changed and full service recovery.

evidence.requirement: Run the installed heartbeat program as svc-heartbeat
evidence.summary: The installed program was identified, left unchanged, and is running as svc-heartbeat.

evidence.requirement: Refresh the heartbeat at least every five seconds
evidence.summary: The heartbeat advanced during both pre- and post-reboot observations and was no more than one second old.
All original hardening directives remained effective before and after reboot.
Healthy baseline boot ID f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 2915c282-8fbc-43a0-a7ca-accaa2ae9d04 observed, and service/data recovery verified.
